import { type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { type ValueChangeDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { type KrdsLocale } from '../../providers/index.js';
import { type DateModeProps, type DateValue } from './model.js';
export interface CalendarTranslations {
    previousMonth: string;
    nextMonth: string;
    today: string;
    clear: string;
    cancel: string;
    confirm: string;
    selected: string;
    unavailable: string;
    adjacentMonth: string;
    dateLabel: string;
    visibleDayLabel: string;
    monthLabel: string;
    startLabel: string;
    endLabel: string;
    weekdayNames: string[];
    weekdayShortNames: string[];
    monthNames: string[];
}
export declare function calendarTranslations(locale: KrdsLocale, overrides?: Partial<CalendarTranslations>): CalendarTranslations;
export type CalendarProps = DateModeProps & {
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    referenceDate?: string;
    today?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
    locale?: KrdsLocale;
    translations?: Partial<CalendarTranslations>;
    label?: ReactNode;
    'aria-label'?: string;
    'aria-labelledby'?: string;
    id?: string;
    onConfirm?: (details: ValueChangeDetails<DateValue>) => void;
    onCancel?: () => void; /** Popup integration focuses a selected/first date after mount. */
    autoFocus?: boolean;
};
export declare function Calendar(props: CalendarProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
